Messages.Author: Bram Vink
Messages.Body:
Curse of Nitocris,

Unique. Choose a Methuselah to take control of this card. The
controller of this card burns 1 pool during each of his or her untap
phases. Each time a new Methuselah gets the Edge, the current
controller of this card chooses the next controller.

2 short questions.

1: I control the edge, and burn it. I then get the edge again. Does
the current controller get to choose the next controller?

2: If I control the curse, can I choose myself as the next controller
when able to choose the next controller? (or does "next" imply it has
to be another methuselah?)

Cheers,

B
